status: Approved character design and creative planning reference; not proof of generated games or films
premise: Whisker and Luna restore the six Power Crystals to Pawtopia through courageous, kind choices. Their ultimate challenge is to save, not destroy, the Baron Brasswhirl.

Whisker.visual: Orange/gold tabby; cream muzzle; warm brown forehead and cheek stripes; Green eyes, pink cat nose, white whiskers, swept orange crest, confident friendly expression; Midnight navy and red suit with gold piping; gold pauldrons, bracers and knee guards; dark gloves; red cape with gold trim; paw shield and paw belt buckle
Whisker.voice: energetic, warm, expressive; consistent across releases

Luna.visual: Silver/white with charcoal tabby markings and pale lavender highlights; Violet eyes, pink cat nose, fine whiskers, pale silver/lavender side-swept hair, friendly confident expression; Deep purple suit, layered silver shoulder armor, silver bracers and boot guards, cyan piping, crescent chest emblem and belt buckle; purple gloves
Luna.voice: clear, confident, witty; consistent across releases

Baron Brasswhirl.role: Main antagonist and final boss across Super Paw Heroes
Baron Brasswhirl.design_status: User-approved master concept; playable procedural model is an approximation
Baron Brasswhirl.visual: Brown fur, tan muzzle, amber eyes, large dark canine nose, long floppy ears, confident smirk; navy/charcoal suit, brass/copper armor and cog chest emblem; burgundy cape, gadget utility belt, brass spiral gauntlet, armored boots, canine tail
Baron Brasswhirl.personality: Clever, theatrical, boastful gadget inventor; mischievous and kid-friendly
Baron Brasswhirl.continuity: Use this same face, fur, ears, costume, colors and gadgets in game art, stories, films, books, posters and website artwork. Do not substitute a generic dog or rename him Regent Nullstar.
Baron Brasswhirl.voice: Not yet selected; do not invent an approved voice profile

rules: Every release fits the canonical timeline.
Kid-safe jokes never humiliate or exclude others.
Consequences matter; honest apologies and repair matter.
Gadgets and powers remain consistent with previously released stories.
No external website redirects targeting children without family-safe review.
Any new cross-media continuity event requires human approval.
Follow cross_media_villain_policy and the approved mini_bosses roster in every new or revised Super Paw Heroes release.

mini_boss_policy: Every district uses its own reserved mini-boss breed and silhouette, different from regular enemies and from Baron Brasswhirl's brown floppy-eared hound design. Baron remains the separate main boss, not a mini-boss.

rules: Whisker and Luna remain the canonical cat heroes.
Baron Brasswhirl is the separate main antagonist; use his approved master image consistently.
Each level, episode or story arc has its own mini-boss dog breed and recognizable silhouette, separate from both ordinary dog villains and the main boss.
Reserve the approved mini-boss breeds for their named leaders; do not reuse them for ordinary villains or substitute a recolored main-boss model.
Retain the mini-boss names, breeds, coat patterns, proportions, costume motifs, personalities and signature powers across media.
Vary locations, map routes and enemy encounters between levels or story arcs; preserve continuity when resuming a saved campaign.
Use the six approved mini-boss assignments as the initial roster. New arcs need new original leaders with unused breeds and designs.
Keep villains mischievous and child-friendly; defeats use non-graphic outcomes and allow redemption.
Apply villains only where the format needs them; quiet coloring, learning or music activities need not force combat.
cross_media_villain_policy.implementation_status: Six breed-specific mini-bosses and separate final boss are implemented in Crystal Catacombs. Other media inherit this creative specification; they are not automatically regenerated by this policy update.

hero_implementation_status: Shared refined model and runtime motion in Crystal Catacombs and character studio. New local game drafts embed the same source. Existing films and artwork are not regenerated.
